runtime_under_test.reason_for_direct_controller_use: WebRuntime adds idle background scheduling, optional TTS and log writes that are not part of a single response condition. Formal response scoring uses the same brain controller directly and freezes those external side effects off.
runtime_under_test.current_goal_nonconformance: Deterministic RightBrain reply families are present. They make the current system executable but do not satisfy the long-term requirement that public-persona fidelity generalize without fixed replies.

isolated_single_scenario.memory: temporary empty evaluation database initialized identically for every condition
isolated_single_scenario.state_updates: allowed only after the scored reply and discarded with the scenario

isolated_dynamic_episode.brain_lifetime: one fresh brain per frozen episode
isolated_dynamic_episode.memory: temporary empty evaluation database shared only by ordered turns in that episode
isolated_dynamic_episode.state_updates: retained within the episode and discarded before the next episode

conditional_model_calls.leftbrain_general_plan: zero for rule-covered inputs, otherwise one qwen2.5:7b call
conditional_model_calls.social_reasoning_frame: zero normally; an additional qwen2.5:7b call may occur for recognized story reasoning probes
conditional_model_calls.background_consolidation: not invoked by the formal synchronous turn harness

conditions.intended_single_difference: remove structured cognitive intermediate state while preserving the same local model artifact, allowed persona evidence, per-item model-call count, total context and output budget, decoding, postprocessing and action permissions
current_blockers: S0 model-call count is input-dependent because rule plans bypass the model while some story probes add a model call
S0 persona information is distributed across LeftBrain rules, planner prompt, RightBrain policies and surface families rather than one frozen equal-budget provider
no direct-control adapter currently records and enforces per-item compute and context parity

conditions.intended_single_difference: replace target public-persona policy with an equal-size neutral Japanese dialogue policy while preserving every cognitive module, model, memory state, resource budget and safety rule
current_blockers: target persona behavior is cross-cutting in LeftBrain rules and prompts plus RightBrain fallback and intent families
PUBLIC_PERSONA_CONDITIONAL_BRIEF is not the only active source of persona behavior
disabling one environment flag therefore does not create a persona-disabled matched condition

conditions.intended_difference: one local model call with a compact persona prompt and no cognitive pipeline
conditions.interpretation_limit: A score gap against this condition measures the combined package and cannot prove which module or persona mechanism caused the gap.

future_single_component_ablation_candida.matched_replacement: same token budget filled by recent-context-only retrieval
fixed high-road route with the same downstream planner
frozen neutral mood and trust state
single-plan planner with identical input evidence and model-call budget
generic Japanese semantic realizer with the same plan and length contract
pass-through output with identical upstream candidates
read-only episode state within an otherwise identical dynamic episode

claim_boundary: S0 can be frozen now. C1 and C2 cannot be honestly executed until their missing adapters exist and parity is machine-checked. A prompt-only lower bound is still useful descriptively but is not the sole fair control and cannot identify a component cause.
